reason: I already paid for salon software once and my girls never touched it, we went back to the register within weeks. An English-only app on their phones will go the same way, and I am not paying ₹4,999 to learn that lesson twice.
objection: It is only in English. My staff will not type numbers and bill in an English app on a busy Sunday or in Diwali week, they will just write it in the register like always.
would_change_my_mind: The app in Hindi, and letting me pay the ₹4,999 setup only after the first free month if my staff are actually billing on it every day.
